annotations.title: View a photo, video or PDF

description: Look at one stored picture of this workspace: the answer is the picture itself. Use it on every picture templates_render made, before showing it to the user: check that no line is cut off, that the words fit their space and that the photo sits well, and render again if not. A video answers with its still picture. A PDF up to 2 MB answers as a document resource. Larger PDFs return file details. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

id.description: A media id from media_upload or media_list.
